gamerule.afetBlokHasari.description: When off, disasters do not break, burn, freeze or thaw blocks.
gamerule.afetMaksSiddet.description: Highest level a disaster can reach (1-5).
gamerule.asitYagmuruAfeti.description: Allows acid rain to be chosen.
gamerule.ayCarpmasiAfeti.description: Allows the moon impact to be chosen. Turning it off stops an unfinished process; reached eras stay.
gamerule.dogalAfetlerAcik.description: Turns the whole disaster system on or off.
gamerule.gunesPatlamasiAfeti.description: Allows the solar flare to be chosen. Turning it off stops an unfinished process; reached eras stay.
gamerule.sicaklikSistemi.description: Turns the body temperature system and its HUD on or off.
